subject: math
concept_overview: Explain the derivative as an instantaneous rate of change using motion, slope, and tangent lines.
mastery_points: Students can interpret positive, negative, and zero derivative values; connect derivative units to real contexts; and estimate a derivative from a graph.
design_idea: Create a micro lesson with prediction questions, a draggable point on a curve, visual slope comparison, one worked example, one misconception repair, and one transfer problem.
description: High-school calculus active learning micro lesson.
